# Reading in the files
``` {r reading in the data, cache = TRUE}
main_dir <- "ARS Videos for Worm Lab/"

# Grab all CSV files, discard BatchExport or csv0 files
csv_files <- fs::dir_ls(
  main_dir,
  recurse = TRUE,
  regexp = "\\.csv$"
) %>%
  discard(~ str_detect(basename(.x), regex("BatchExport|csv0", ignore_case = TRUE)))

# Build metadata table
metadata <- tibble(file_path = csv_files) %>%
  mutate(
    path_split = str_split(file_path, .Platform$file.sep),

    date_folder = map_chr(path_split, ~ .x[length(.x) - 3]),
    treatment_folder = map_chr(path_split, ~ .x[length(.x) - 2]),
    video_number = map_chr(path_split, ~ .x[length(.x) - 1]),

    file_name = basename(file_path),

    # Extract date
    date = str_extract(date_folder, "\\d{8}")
  ) %>%
  separate(
    treatment_folder,
    into = c("strain", "treatment", "timing"),
    sep = " - "
  ) %>%
  mutate(
  treatment = case_when(
    str_to_lower(treatment) == "solv" ~ "Solv Ctrl",
    TRUE ~ treatment
  ),

  file_type = case_when(
      str_detect(file_name, regex("bending angle", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "bending_angle",
      str_detect(file_name, regex("track", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "track_summary",
      str_detect(file_name, regex("omega", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "omega_bends",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    ),

    # Flag duplicate files you do NOT want to keep
    has_bad_suffix = str_detect(file_name, fixed("SPH-8F86D14-EHS")),

    # Create cleaned name so duplicate versions collapse together
    file_name_clean = str_remove_all(file_name, fixed("SPH-8F86D14-EHS"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(date, strain, treatment, timing, video_number, file_type, file_name_clean) %>%
  arrange(has_bad_suffix, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    date,
    strain,
    treatment,
    timing,
    video_number,
    file_type,
    file_name,
    file_path
  )

metadata %>%
  filter(file_type == "unknown") %>%
  dplyr::select(file_path, file_name)

# Check that the strain labeling is accurate
metadata %>%
  filter(!strain %in% c("N2", "BZ555", "UA44")) %>%
  distinct(strain, file_path)

# Check how many videos each folder has
metadata %>%
  filter(file_type != "unknown") %>%
  count(date, strain, treatment, timing, video_number)

# Function to read & parse WormLab files
read_wormlab_file <- function(file_path, file_type) {
  if (file_type == "track_summary") {
    df <- read_csv(file_path, skip = 1, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)

    df_param <- df[, 1, drop = FALSE]
    worm_string <- df[[2]]

    worm_data <- str_split(worm_string, pattern = ",", simplify = TRUE)
    worm_data <- apply(worm_data, 2, as.numeric)

    df_clean <- cbind(df_param, as_tibble(worm_data))
    n_worms <- ncol(df_clean) - 1
    colnames(df_clean) <- c("parameter", as.character(seq_len(n_worms)))

    df_clean <- df_clean %>% slice(-(1:2))

    return(df_clean)

  } else if (file_type == "bending_angle") {
    df <- read_csv(file_path, skip = 2, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)

    df_frame_time <- df[, 1:2]
    worm_string <- df[[3]]

    worm_data <- str_split(worm_string, pattern = ",", simplify = TRUE)
    worm_data <- apply(worm_data, 2, as.numeric)

    df_clean <- cbind(df_frame_time, as_tibble(worm_data))
    n_worms <- ncol(df_clean) - 2
    colnames(df_clean) <- c("Frame", "Time", as.character(seq_len(n_worms)))

    df_clean <- df_clean %>% slice(-(1:2))

    return(df_clean)

  } else if (file_type == "omega_bends") {
    df <- read_csv(file_path, skip = 2, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)

    df_frame_time <- df[, 1:2]
    worm_string <- df[[3]]

    worm_data <- str_split(worm_string, pattern = ",", simplify = TRUE)

    worm_data <- apply(
      worm_data,
      2,
      function(x) ifelse(str_detect(x, regex("Omega Bend", ignore_case = TRUE)), 1, 0)
    )

    df_clean <- cbind(df_frame_time, as_tibble(worm_data))
    n_worms <- ncol(df_clean) - 2
    colnames(df_clean) <- c("Frame", "Time", as.character(seq_len(n_worms)))

    df_clean <- df_clean %>% slice(-(1:2))

    return(df_clean)

  } else {
    stop("Unknown file type: ", file_type)
  }
}

#Apply to all valid files

data_list <- metadata %>%
  filter(file_type != "unknown") %>%
  mutate(
    data = map2(file_path, file_type, read_wormlab_file)
  )
```

``` {r splitting by experiment, cache = TRUE}
# cleaning up the data further
get_valid_worms <- function(track_df) {

  durations <- track_df %>%
    filter(parameter == "Track duration (s)") %>%
    dplyr::select(-parameter) %>%
    unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
    as.numeric()

  which(durations >= 29)
}

filter_worms <- function(df, valid_worms) {

  worm_cols <- as.character(valid_worms)

  if ("Frame" %in% names(df)) {
    df %>% dplyr::select(Frame, Time, any_of(worm_cols))
  } else {
    df %>% dplyr::select(parameter, any_of(worm_cols))
  }
}

worms_to_long <- function(df) {

  if ("Frame" %in% names(df)) {

    df %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -c(Frame, Time),
        names_to = "worm",
        values_to = "value"
      ) %>%
      mutate(worm = as.integer(worm))

  } else {

    df %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -parameter,
        names_to = "worm",
        values_to = "value"
      ) %>%
      mutate(worm = as.integer(worm))

  }
}

expt_1_processed <- expt_1 %>%
  group_by(date, strain, treatment, timing, video_number) %>%
  group_modify(~{

    track <- .x %>%
      filter(file_type == "track_summary") %>%
      pull(data) %>%
      .[[1]]

    omega <- .x %>%
      filter(file_type == "omega_bends") %>%
      pull(data) %>%
      .[[1]]

    bend <- .x %>%
      filter(file_type == "bending_angle") %>%
      pull(data) %>%
      .[[1]]

    # Determine worms tracked >= 29 s
    valid_worms <- get_valid_worms(track)

    # Filter worms
    track_clean <- filter_worms(track, valid_worms)
    omega_clean <- filter_worms(omega, valid_worms)
    bend_clean  <- filter_worms(bend, valid_worms)

    # Convert to long format
    track_long <- worms_to_long(track_clean)
    omega_long <- worms_to_long(omega_clean)
    bend_long  <- worms_to_long(bend_clean)

    tibble(
      track_summary = list(track_long),
      omega_bends = list(omega_long),
      bending_angle = list(bend_long),
      worms_kept = list(valid_worms)
    )

  })
```

``` {r plots of worm sizes}
worm_size <- track_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("Mean Worm Length (um)", "Mean Width (um)")) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = parameter,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  rename(
    length_um = `Mean Worm Length (um)`,
    width_um  = `Mean Width (um)`
  )

set.seed(123)

worm_clusters <- worm_size %>%
  group_by(strain, treatment, date) %>%
  group_modify(~{

    dat <- .x

    km <- kmeans(
      scale(dat[, c("length_um", "width_um")]),
      centers = 2
    )

    dat$cluster <- km$cluster

    dat
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(
  worm_clusters,
  aes(x = length_um, y = width_um, color = factor(cluster))
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  facet_grid(strain + treatment ~ date) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Worm Clusters by Condition",
    x = "Mean Worm Length (µm)",
    y = "Mean Worm Width (µm)",
    color = "Cluster"
  )
```

# Raw Data Analysis
##Track Metrics and Stats
``` {r filtering track metrics - tca}
track_metrics_tca <- track_tca %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c(
    "Absolute Peristaltic Track Length (um) [forward + reversals]",
    "Peristaltic Speed (um/s) [Absolute peristaltic track length/time]",
    "Number of Reversals",
    "Mean Worm Length (um)",
    "Wavelength (um)",
    "Turn Count"
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    value = as.numeric(value),
    timing = factor(timing, levels = c("5 min", "30 min")),
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("N2", "BZ555", "UA44"))
  )

ylabel_map_raw <- c(
  "Absolute Peristaltic Track Length (um) [forward + reversals]" = "Track Length (um)",
  "Peristaltic Speed (um/s) [Absolute peristaltic track length/time]" = "Peristaltic Speed (um/s)",
  "Number of Reversals" = "Number of Reversals",
  "Mean Worm Length (um)" = "Mean Worm Length (um)",
  "Wavelength (um)" = "Wavelength (um)",
  "Turn Count" = "Turn Count"
)

track_summary_tca_raw <- track_metrics_tca %>%
  group_by(parameter, day, strain, treatment, timing) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(value)),
    se_value = sd_value / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

metrics <- unique(track_summary_tca_raw$parameter)
```

``` {r stats tests for TCA track metrics - ANOVA}
track_metrics_tca <- track_metrics_tca %>%

    residuals = res
  )
})
```

``` {r plotting track metrics - tca}
    )
})
```

##Omega Events and Stats
``` {r compute omega events and durations}
# Helper: count events lasting >= min_frames consecutive frames
count_bend_events_min_duration <- function(x, min_frames = 7) {
  x <- as.integer(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- 0L
  r <- rle(x)
  sum(r$values == 1L & r$lengths >= min_frames)
}

# Helper: return durations (in frames) of qualifying events
get_event_durations <- function(x, min_frames = 7) {
  x <- as.integer(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- 0L
  r <- rle(x)
  as.numeric(r$lengths[r$values == 1L & r$lengths >= min_frames])
}

#Omega events per worm
omega_events_tca <- omega_tca %>%
  mutate(
    Time  = as.numeric(Time),
    value = as.numeric(value),
    timing = factor(timing, levels = c("5 min", "30 min")),
    day    = factor(day,    levels = c("Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 5")),
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("N2", "BZ555", "UA44"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(expt, day, strain, treatment, timing, worm, video_number) %>%
  arrange(Time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    n_omega_events = count_bend_events_min_duration(value, 7),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

omega_events_summary_tca <- omega_events_tca %>%
  group_by(day, strain, treatment, timing) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(n_omega_events, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value   = sd(n_omega_events,   na.rm = TRUE),
    n          = sum(!is.na(n_omega_events)),
    se_value   = sd_value / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

omega_events_tceoh <- omega_tceoh %>%
  mutate(
    Time  = as.numeric(Time),
    value = as.numeric(value),
    timing = factor(timing, levels = c("5 min", "30 min")),
    day    = factor(day,    levels = c("Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 5")),
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("N2", "BZ555", "UA44"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(expt, day, strain, treatment, timing, worm, video_number) %>%
  arrange(Time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    n_omega_events = count_bend_events_min_duration(value, 7),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

omega_events_summary_tceoh <- omega_events_tceoh %>%
  group_by(day, strain, treatment, timing) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(n_omega_events, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value   = sd(n_omega_events,   na.rm = TRUE),
    n          = sum(!is.na(n_omega_events)),
    se_value   = sd_value / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Omega durations
omega_duration_tca <- omega_tca %>%
  mutate(
    Time  = as.numeric(Time),
    value = as.numeric(value),
    timing = factor(timing, levels = c("5 min", "30 min")),
    day    = factor(day,    levels = c("Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 5")),
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("N2", "BZ555", "UA44"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(expt, day, strain, treatment, timing, worm, video_number) %>%
  arrange(Time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    durations_frames = list(get_event_durations(value, min_frames = 7)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(durations_sec = map(durations_frames, ~ .x / 7))

# With zeros (worms with no events get mean_duration = 0)
omega_duration_summary_tca <- omega_duration_tca %>%
  mutate(
    mean_duration   = map_dbl(durations_sec, ~ if (length(.x) == 0) 0 else mean(.x)),
    median_duration = map_dbl(durations_sec, ~ if (length(.x) == 0) 0 else median(.x)),
    n_events        = map_int(durations_sec, length)
  )

omega_duration_summary_plot_tca <- omega_duration_summary_tca %>%
  group_by(day, strain, treatment, timing) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(mean_duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value   = sd(mean_duration,   na.rm = TRUE),
    n          = sum(!is.na(mean_duration)),
    se_value   = sd_value / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Without zeros
omega_duration_summary_tca_nonzero <- omega_duration_tca %>%
  mutate(
    mean_duration   = map_dbl(durations_sec, ~ if (length(.x) == 0) NA_real_ else mean(.x)),
    median_duration = map_dbl(durations_sec, ~ if (length(.x) == 0) NA_real_ else median(.x)),
    n_events        = map_int(durations_sec, length)
  )

omega_duration_summary_plot_tca_nonzero <- omega_duration_summary_tca_nonzero %>%
  group_by(day, strain, treatment, timing) %>%

omega_duration_tceoh <- omega_tceoh %>%
```

``` {r stats for omega events - tceoh}
  data = omega_events_tceoh,
  type = 3,
  white.adjust = TRUE
)

omega_binary_tceoh <- omega_events_tceoh %>%
  mutate(
    any_omega = factor(if_else(n_omega_events > 0, 1, 0))
  )

model_omega_binary_tceoh <- glm(
  any_omega ~ timing * treatment * strain,
  data = omega_binary_tceoh,
  family = binomial
)

omega_residual_checks_tceoh <- list(
  parameter = "omega_events",
  shapiro = shapiro.test(residuals(model_omega_tceoh$lm)),
  residuals = residuals(model_omega_tceoh$lm)
)

qqnorm(residuals(model_omega_tceoh$lm))
qqline(residuals(model_omega_tceoh$lm))
```

##High-angled Bend Events and Stats
``` {r compute bend90 events and durations}
#High-angled bend (>=90 deg) events per worm
bend90_events_tca <- bending_tca %>%
  mutate(
    Time  = as.numeric(Time),
    value = as.numeric(value),
    timing = factor(timing, levels = c("5 min", "30 min")),
    day    = factor(day,    levels = c("Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 5")),
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("N2", "BZ555", "UA44")),
    bend90 = if_else(abs(value) >= 90, 1L, 0L)
  ) %>%
  group_by(expt, day, strain, treatment, timing, worm, video_number) %>%
  arrange(Time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    n_bend90_events = count_bend_events_min_duration(bend90, min_frames = 7),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bend90_events_summary_tca <- bend90_events_tca %>%
  group_by(day, strain, treatment, timing) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(n_bend90_events, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value   = sd(n_bend90_events,   na.rm = TRUE),
    n          = sum(!is.na(n_bend90_events)),
    se_value   = sd_value / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bend90_events_tceoh <- bending_tceoh %>%
  mutate(
    Time  = as.numeric(Time),
    value = as.numeric(value),
    timing = factor(timing, levels = c("5 min", "30 min")),
    day    = factor(day,    levels = c("Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 5")),
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("N2", "BZ555", "UA44")),
    bend90 = if_else(abs(value) >= 90, 1L, 0L)
  ) %>%
  group_by(expt, day, strain, treatment, timing, worm, video_number) %>%
  arrange(Time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    n_bend90_events = count_bend_events_min_duration(bend90, min_frames = 7),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bend90_events_summary_tceoh <- bend90_events_tceoh %>%
  group_by(day, strain, treatment, timing) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(n_bend90_events, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value   = sd(n_bend90_events,   na.rm = TRUE),
    n          = sum(!is.na(n_bend90_events)),
    se_value   = sd_value / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#High-angled bend durations per worm
bending_duration_tca <- bending_tca %>%
  mutate(
    Time  = as.numeric(Time),
    value = as.numeric(value),
    timing = factor(timing, levels = c("5 min", "30 min")),
    day    = factor(day,    levels = c("Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 5")),
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("N2", "BZ555", "UA44")),
    bend90 = if_else(abs(value) >= 90, 1L, 0L)
  ) %>%
  group_by(expt, day, strain, treatment, timing, worm, video_number) %>%
  arrange(Time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    durations_frames = list(get_event_durations(bend90, min_frames = 7)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    durations_sec = map(durations_frames, ~ .x / 7),
    mean_duration = map_dbl(durations_sec, ~ if (length(.x) == 0) 0 else mean(.x))
  )

bending_duration_summary_tca <- bending_duration_tca %>%
  group_by(day, strain, treatment, timing) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(mean_duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value   = sd(mean_duration,   na.rm = TRUE),
    n          = sum(!is.na(mean_duration)),
    se_value   = sd_value / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bending_duration_tceoh <- bending_tceoh %>%
  mutate(
    Time  = as.numeric(Time),
    value = as.numeric(value),
    timing = factor(timing, levels = c("5 min", "30 min")),
    day    = factor(day,    levels = c("Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 5")),
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("N2", "BZ555", "UA44")),
    bend90 = if_else(abs(value) >= 90, 1L, 0L)
  ) %>%
  group_by(expt, day, strain, treatment, timing, worm, video_number) %>%
  arrange(Time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    durations_frames = list(get_event_durations(bend90, min_frames = 7)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    durations_sec = map(durations_frames, ~ .x / 7),
    mean_duration = map_dbl(durations_sec, ~ if (length(.x) == 0) 0 else mean(.x))
  )

bending_duration_summary_tceoh <- bending_duration_tceoh %>%
  group_by(day, strain, treatment, timing) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(mean_duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value   = sd(mean_duration,   na.rm = TRUE),
    n          = sum(!is.na(mean_duration)),
    se_value   = sd_value / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# Normalizing Data and Analysis
``` {r track metrics normalized}
#Average 5 min timepoint, then divide individual 5 min and 30 min values by average
track_metrics_tca_norm <- track_metrics_tca %>%
  group_by(expt, strain, parameter) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_5min = mean(value[timing == "5 min" & treatment == "Ctrl"], na.rm = TRUE),
    ratio_value_norm = (value / baseline_5min) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    expt_num = gsub("Expt ", "", expt),
    worm_id = paste(expt_num, strain, treatment, date, video_number, timing, paste0("rep", worm), sep = "_")
  )

track_metrics_tceoh_norm <- track_metrics_tceoh %>%
  group_by(expt, strain, parameter) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_5min = mean(value[timing == "5 min" & treatment == "Solv Ctrl"], na.rm = TRUE),
    ratio_value_norm = (value / baseline_5min) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    expt_num = gsub("Expt ", "", expt),
    worm_id = paste(expt_num, strain, treatment, date, video_number, timing, paste0("rep", worm), sep = "_")
  )

ylabel_map <- c(
  "Absolute Peristaltic Track Length (um) [forward + reversals]" = "% Control of Track Length",
  "Mean Worm Length (um)" = "% Control of Worm Length",
  "Peristaltic Speed (um/s) [Absolute peristaltic track length/time]" = "% Control of Peristaltic Speed",
  "Wavelength (um)" = "% Control of Wavelength",
  "Turn Count" = "% Control of Turn Count",
  "Number of Reversals" = "% Control of Number of Reversals"
)
```

##Track Metrics and Stats - Normalized
``` {r stats for normalized track metrics - tca}
track_metrics_tca_norm <- track_metrics_tca_norm %>%
  mutate(
    timing = factor(timing, levels = c("5 min", "30 min")),
    treatment = factor(treatment),
    strain = factor(strain),
    worm_id = factor(worm_id)
  )

models_tca_norm <- track_metrics_tca_norm %>%
  split(.$parameter) %>%
  map(~ aov_ez(
    id = "worm_id",
    dv = "ratio_value_norm",
    between = c("timing", "treatment", "strain"),
    data = .x,
    type = 3,
    white.adjust = TRUE
  ))

residual_checks_tca_norm <- imap(models_tca_norm, ~ {
  mod <- .x$lm
  res <- residuals(mod)
  list(parameter = .y, shapiro = shapiro.test(res), residuals = res)
})

qqnorm(residuals(models_tca_norm[[1]]$lm)); qqline(residuals(models_tca_norm[[1]]$lm))
qqnorm(residuals(models_tca_norm[[2]]$lm)); qqline(residuals(models_tca_norm[[2]]$lm))
qqnorm(residuals(models_tca_norm[[3]]$lm)); qqline(residuals(models_tca_norm[[3]]$lm))
qqnorm(residuals(models_tca_norm[[4]]$lm)); qqline(residuals(models_tca_norm[[4]]$lm))
qqnorm(residuals(models_tca_norm[[5]]$lm)); qqline(residuals(models_tca_norm[[5]]$lm))
qqnorm(residuals(models_tca_norm[[6]]$lm)); qqline(residuals(models_tca_norm[[6]]$lm))
```

``` {r CLD for normalized track metrics - tca}
cld_tca_norm <- models_tca_norm %>%
  imap_dfr(~ {
    emmeans(.x, ~ treatment * strain * timing) %>%
      cld(adjust = "sidak", Letters = letters) %>%
      as.data.frame()
  }, .id = "parameter") %>%
  mutate(.group = trimws(.group))
```

``` {r plotting normalized track metrics - tca}
track_summary_tca_norm <- track_metrics_tca_norm %>%
  group_by(parameter, strain, treatment, timing) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(ratio_value_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value = sd(ratio_value_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(ratio_value_norm)),
    se_value = sd_value / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cld_labels_tca_norm <- cld_tca_norm %>%
  left_join(
    track_summary_tca_norm %>%
      dplyr::select(parameter, strain, treatment, timing, mean_value, se_value),
    by = c("parameter", "strain", "treatment", "timing")
  ) %>%
  mutate(label_y = mean_value + se_value)

plots_tca_norm <- lapply(metrics, function(m) {
  df <- track_summary_tca_norm %>% filter(parameter == m)
  cld_df <- cld_labels_tca_norm %>% filter(parameter == m)
  
  y_lab <- if (m %in% names(ylabel_map)) ylabel_map[m] else "Percent Control of Value"
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = treatment, y = mean_value, fill = timing)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = mean_value - se_value, ymax = mean_value + se_value),
      position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = cld_df,
      aes(x = treatment, y = label_y, label = .group, group = timing),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~strain) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("5 min" = "#1f77b4", "30 min" = "#d62728")) +
    labs(x = "Treatment", y = y_lab, fill = "Timing", title = m) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.6, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.6, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
})
```

``` {r stats for normalized track metrics - tceoh}
models_tceoh_norm <- track_metrics_tceoh_norm %>%
  split(.$parameter) %>%
  map(~ aov_ez(
    id = "worm_id",
    dv = "ratio_value_norm",
    between = c("timing", "treatment", "strain"),
    data = .x,
    type = 3,
    white.adjust = TRUE
  ))

residual_checks_tceoh_norm <- imap(models_tceoh_norm, ~ {
  mod <- .x$lm
  res <- residuals(mod)
  list(parameter = .y, shapiro = shapiro.test(res), residuals = res)
})

qqnorm(residuals(models_tceoh_norm[[1]]$lm)); qqline(residuals(models_tceoh_norm[[1]]$lm))
qqnorm(residuals(models_tceoh_norm[[2]]$lm)); qqline(residuals(models_tceoh_norm[[2]]$lm))
qqnorm(residuals(models_tceoh_norm[[3]]$lm)); qqline(residuals(models_tceoh_norm[[3]]$lm))
qqnorm(residuals(models_tceoh_norm[[4]]$lm)); qqline(residuals(models_tceoh_norm[[4]]$lm))
qqnorm(residuals(models_tceoh_norm[[5]]$lm)); qqline(residuals(models_tceoh_norm[[5]]$lm))
qqnorm(residuals(models_tceoh_norm[[6]]$lm)); qqline(residuals(models_tceoh_norm[[6]]$lm))
```

``` {r CLD for normalized track metrics - tceoh}
cld_tceoh_norm <- models_tceoh_norm %>%
  imap_dfr(~ {
    emmeans(.x, ~ treatment * strain * timing) %>%
      cld(adjust = "sidak", Letters = letters) %>%
      as.data.frame()
  }, .id = "parameter") %>%
  mutate(.group = trimws(.group))
```

``` {r plotting normalized track metrics - tceoh}
track_summary_tceoh_norm <- track_metrics_tceoh_norm %>%
  group_by(parameter, strain, treatment, timing) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(ratio_value_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value = sd(ratio_value_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(ratio_value_norm)),
    se_value = sd_value / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cld_labels_tceoh_norm <- cld_tceoh_norm %>%
  left_join(
    track_summary_tceoh_norm %>%
      dplyr::select(parameter, strain, treatment, timing, mean_value, se_value),
    by = c("parameter", "strain", "treatment", "timing")
  ) %>%
  mutate(label_y = mean_value + se_value)

plots_tceoh_norm <- lapply(metrics, function(m) {
  df <- track_summary_tceoh_norm %>% filter(parameter == m)
  cld_df <- cld_labels_tceoh_norm %>% filter(parameter == m)
  
  y_lab <- if (m %in% names(ylabel_map)) ylabel_map[m] else "Normalized Value"
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = treatment, y = mean_value, fill = timing)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = mean_value - se_value, ymax = mean_value + se_value),
      position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = cld_df,
      aes(x = treatment, y = label_y, label = .group, group = timing),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~strain) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("5 min" = "#1f77b4", "30 min" = "#d62728")) +
    labs(x = "Treatment", y = y_lab, fill = "Timing", title = m) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.6, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.6, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
})

plots_tceoh_norm[[1]]
plots_tceoh_norm[[2]]
plots_tceoh_norm[[3]]
plots_tceoh_norm[[4]]
plots_tceoh_norm[[5]]
plots_tceoh_norm[[6]]

for (i in seq_along(plots_tceoh_norm)) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("Day 5/track_tceoh_norm_", i, ".png"),
    plot = plots_tceoh_norm[[i]],
    width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300
  )
}
```

##Omega Bend Behavior - Proportions
``` {r omega proportions - tca}
omega_summary_tca <- omega_events_tca %>%
  mutate(
    any_omega = if_else(n_omega_events > 0, 1L, 0L),
    timing = factor(timing, levels = c("5 min", "30 min")),
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("N2", "BZ555", "UA44"))
  )

omega_prop_worms_tca <- omega_summary_tca %>%
  group_by(day, strain, treatment, timing) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(any_omega),
    sd_value = sd(any_omega),
    n = n(),
    se_value = sd_value / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

omega_time_tca <- omega_duration_tca %>%
  mutate(
    total_duration = map_dbl(durations_sec, ~ if (length(.x) == 0) 0 else sum(.x)),
    prop_time_omega = total_duration / 30,
    timing = factor(timing, levels = c("5 min", "30 min")),
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("N2", "BZ555", "UA44"))
  )

omega_time_summary_tca <- omega_time_tca %>%
  group_by(day, strain, treatment, timing) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(prop_time_omega, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value = sd(prop_time_omega, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(prop_time_omega)),
    se_value = sd_value / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

``` {r logistic regression for omega proportions - tca}
omega_summary_tca <- omega_summary_tca %>%
  mutate(any_omega = factor(any_omega))

model_omega_tca_glm <- glm(
  any_omega ~ strain * treatment * timing,
  data = omega_summary_tca,
  family = binomial
)

summary(model_omega_tca_glm)

# Model for proportion of time in omega
model_omega_time_tca_glm <- glm(
  prop_time_omega ~ strain * treatment * timing,
  data = omega_time_tca,
  family = quasibinomial  # handles continuous proportions 0-1
)

summary(model_omega_time_tca_glm)
```

``` {r CLD for omega proportions - tca}

  mutate(.group = trimws(.group))
```

``` {r bend90 proportions - tceoh}
bend90_summary_tceoh <- bend90_events_tceoh %>%
  mutate(
    any_bend90 = if_else(n_bend90_events > 0, 1L, 0L),
    timing = factor(timing, levels = c("5 min", "30 min")),
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("N2", "BZ555", "UA44"))
  )

bend90_prop_worms_tceoh <- bend90_summary_tceoh %>%
  group_by(day, strain, treatment, timing) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(any_bend90),
    sd_value = sd(any_bend90),
    n = n(),
    se_value = sd_value / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bend90_time_tceoh <- bending_duration_tceoh %>%
  mutate(
    total_duration = map_dbl(durations_sec, ~ if (length(.x) == 0) 0 else sum(.x)),
    prop_time_bend90 = total_duration / 30,
    timing = factor(timing, levels = c("5 min", "30 min")),
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("N2", "BZ555", "UA44"))
  )

bend90_time_summary_tceoh <- bend90_time_tceoh %>%
  group_by(day, strain, treatment, timing) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(prop_time_bend90, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value = sd(prop_time_bend90, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(prop_time_bend90)),
    se_value = sd_value / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

``` {r logistic regression for bend90 proportions - tceoh}
bend90_summary_tceoh <- bend90_summary_tceoh %>%
  mutate(any_bend90 = factor(any_bend90))

model_bend90_tceoh_glm <- glm(
  any_bend90 ~ strain * treatment * timing,
  data = bend90_summary_tceoh,
  family = binomial
)

summary(model_bend90_tceoh_glm)

model_bend90_time_tceoh_glm <- glm(
  prop_time_bend90 ~ strain * treatment * timing,
  data = bend90_time_tceoh,
  family = quasibinomial
)

summary(model_bend90_time_tceoh_glm)
```

``` {r CLD for bend90 proportions - tceoh}
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(.group = trimws(.group))

  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(.group = trimws(.group))
```

##Binning the Bending Events
``` {r bend angle bins - tca}
bend_bins_tca <- bending_tca %>%
  mutate(
    value = as.numeric(value),
    abs_bend = abs(value),
    bend_bin = case_when(
      abs_bend < 30  ~ "0-30",
      abs_bend < 60  ~ "30-60",
      abs_bend < 90  ~ "60-90",
      abs_bend < 120 ~ "90-120",
      abs_bend < 150 ~ "120-150",
      abs_bend < 180 ~ "150-180",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    bend_bin = factor(bend_bin,
      levels = c("0-30", "30-60", "60-90", "90-120", "120-150", "150-180")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bend_bin))

bend_props_tca <- bend_bins_tca %>%
  group_by(strain, treatment, timing, bend_bin) %>%
  summarise(n_frames = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(strain, treatment, timing, bend_bin, fill = list(n_frames = 0)) %>%
  group_by(strain, treatment, timing) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_frames = n_frames / sum(n_frames),
    prop_percent = prop_frames * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

``` {r stats for bend angle bins - tca}
bend_bins_tca_stats <- bending_tca %>%
  mutate(
    value = as.numeric(value),
    abs_bend = abs(value),
    bend_bin = case_when(
      abs_bend < 60  ~ "low",
      abs_bend < 90  ~ "mid",
      abs_bend >= 90 ~ "high",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    bend_bin = factor(bend_bin, levels = c("low", "mid", "high")),
    timing = factor(timing, levels = c("5 min", "30 min")),
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Ctrl", "TCA")),
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("N2", "BZ555", "UA44"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bend_bin))

bend_props_worm_tca <- bend_bins_tca_stats %>%
  group_by(expt, day, strain, treatment, timing, worm, video_number, bend_bin) %>%
  summarise(n_frames = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(expt, day, strain, treatment, timing, worm, video_number) %>%
  mutate(prop = n_frames / sum(n_frames)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(
    expt, day, strain, treatment, timing, worm, video_number, bend_bin,
    fill = list(prop = 0)
  )

bend_props_wide_tca <- bend_props_worm_tca %>%
  dplyr::select(expt, day, strain, treatment, timing, worm, video_number, bend_bin, prop) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = bend_bin, values_from = prop, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(worm_id = factor(paste(expt, strain, treatment, day, timing, worm, video_number, sep = "_")))

model_high_tca <- aov_ez(
  id = "worm_id",
  dv = "high",
  between = c("strain", "treatment", "timing"),
  data = bend_props_wide_tca,
  type = 3,
  white.adjust = TRUE
)

summary(model_high_tca)
```

``` {r CLD for bend angle bins - tca}
cld_high_tca <- emmeans(model_high_tca, ~ treatment * strain * timing) %>%
  cld(adjust = "sidak", Letters = letters) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(.group = trimws(.group))
```

``` {r plotting bend angle bins - tca}
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.6, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
